call_points.text: NIM is guided to be sustained at around 2.55% supported by repricing and retail growth.
Management reaffirmed FY27 global advances growth target of 11-12% and expressed confidence in exceeding it.
Full-year NIM trajectory guided at 2.50% to 2.60%, sustained by shedding low-yielding assets and expanding RAM credit.
Bank aims to reach a loan mix of 60% RAM credit and 40% corporate advances.
Return on Assets (RoA) is guided to remain above 1% even after ECL implementation.
FY27 Global NIM is guided in the range of 2.50% to 2.60%, compared to 2.51% realized in FY26.
RAM credit grew 19.73% YoY to reach ₹7,30,520 Cr as of March 2026.

operating_notes.text: Redeemed ₹3,000 crore Tier II bonds (ISIN INE476A08050) on maturity.
Standalone Provision Coverage Ratio stood at 94.21% as of March 31, 2026.
Global C-D ratio stood at 78.89% as of March 31, 2026.
Gross NPA stood at 1.84% as of March 31, 2026.
Canara Bank revised MCLR upwards by 5 bps across all tenors effective 12 May 2026, setting 1-year MCLR at 8.75%.
Gold loan portfolio stood at ₹2,45,000 Cr, comprising ₹1.54 lakh Cr agri gold loans and ₹91,000 Cr non-agri.
Total SMA book stood at ₹33,728 Cr (2.75% of advances), down from ₹35,604 Cr in Dec 2025.
FY26 recovery from technically written-off accounts was ₹6,500 Cr, running at ₹1,500-1,600 Cr per quarter.
RBI imposed a ₹2.49 lakh penalty for delayed currency chest reporting.
Gold loan book was ₹2.59 lakh Cr as of 30 June, of which agriculture gold was ₹1.51 lakh Cr, with LTV around 60-65%.
Credit pipeline is about ₹50,000 Cr: ₹18,000 Cr sanctioned but undisbursed across 45 accounts and ₹32,000 Cr of sanctionable proposals across 47 accounts.
ECLGS 5.0: ₹90,000 Cr of eligible accounts identified, ₹11,000 Cr+ sanctioned and ₹10,000 Cr+ disbursed, with ₹5,000-6,000 Cr more expected.
Domestic CASA ratio stood at 29.00% as of September 30, 2026, against the March 2027 guidance of 30%-32%.
Total global business stood at ₹30,72,000 crores as of September 30, 2026.

timeline.summary: Canara Bank completed full redemption of ₹3,000 crore Tier II bonds and paid ₹251.31 crore annual interest.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹31,838.54 Cr (+1.1% YoY), net profit ₹4,574.23 Cr (-9.8% YoY).
Canara Bank released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation, reporting 15.30% global advances growth and issuing FY27 guidance.
Canara Bank reported FY26 net profit of ₹19,187 crore, up 12.69% YoY, with gross NPA improving to 1.84%.
Canara Bank revised its MCLR across all tenors upwards effective 12 May 2026; setting the 1-year rate at 8.75%.
Canara Bank held an earnings conference call on May 11, 2026, discussing Q4 & FY 2025-26 results with analysts/investors at 4:00 PM IST.
Canara Bank held its Q4FY26 earnings call; and outlining a ₹10,000 Cr ECL impact.
Canara Bank’s promoter, President of India, disclosed 62.93% voting rights holding (570,854,839 shares) as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s takeover regulations.
Canara Bank's board approved a capital raising plan of up to ₹8,500 crore via AT-I and Tier II bonds for FY27.
RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹0.42 crore on Canara Bank for non-compliance with KYC and unclaimed deposits directions.
RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹2.50 lakh on Canara Bank for delayed currency chest reporting.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹35,161.97 Cr (+9.6% YoY), net profit ₹5,182.03 Cr (+6.5% YoY).
Canara Bank hosted a Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings conference call on 14.10.2026 at 16:00 IST, with recording available via its website.
On 17 October 2026, Canara Bank filed the transcript of its Q2FY27 earnings conference call.
Canara Bank received RBI approval to exercise the call option on ₹1,500 Cr Basel III AT1 bonds.
